verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a full CLI, SDK and REST API for single-resource actions such as starting one instance by ID, plus marketplace search that returns many offers. Nothing documents a native bulk or batch operation, such as acting on many instances, volumes or endpoints in one call. Scripting loops over the CLI or API would be a developer building block or user-side workaround, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
